name: CityRoots.ai
tagline: Lets residents see how park proposals change greenery and air quality, and vote on them with a wallet.
problem: Cities lose parks and trees with little resident input.
solution: Shows park proposals with satellite greenery (NDVI) and PM2.5 estimates computed by an AI agent, and records votes on a test blockchain to prevent duplicates.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a proposal, see the impact, cast a vote.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “VTHacks - Best Ut Prosim” among 112 submissions.
Uses satellite data to inform a civic vote.

lessons: Put the evidence next to the vote.
